calls.reason: The only evidence is NHTSA opening a phantom-braking probe based on complaints. It shows no finding on what vision-only neural nets can do or whether Level 5 was feasible in February 2022.

The UCLA logic paper supports one of the four concerns, and the same paper shows BERT has the capacity to do the reasoning. Nothing independent covers the other concerns or whether his criteria stayed the same.

The Geirhos shortcut-learning synthesis and the HANS study both document repeated cases where benchmark success failed under harder tests. The ImageNet replication shows some gains transfer but doesn't undo the point that progress is often illusory.
No independent replication of the September wheel tests exists. The Conwell–Ullman study tested DALL-E 2 earlier, with different relation prompts, so it is only adjacent.
